changes.before: ...who do you contact first in the servicing legal office?
changes.reason: Two of the four distractors (the contractor's program manager, the COR) are not in the servicing legal office at all, so the original qualifier let a candidate eliminate them without knowing the fraud channel. Removing the qualifier makes the item test the Procurement Fraud Advisor channel itself. Correct option unchanged and still matches the bank answer (AFARS 5109.406-3; AR 27-40 ch. 8).

changes.after: RFO FAR 12.201-1 (BPAs under simplified procedures for commercial products and services; the RFO moved commercial simplified procedures out of Part 13 into Part 12) and RFO FAR 13 (simplified procedures for noncommercial acquisitions); 31 U.S.C. 1501
changes.reason: regulations.json (threshold id sap_commercial_ceiling, confidence verified, verified 13 Sep 2026) records that the RFO moved commercial simplified procedures out of Part 13 into Part 12 and that RFO Part 13 is 'Simplified Procedures for Noncommercial Acquisitions' only; the crosswalk carries FAR 13.5 -> FAR 12.201-1 and FAR 13.004(a)(b) -> FAR 12.201-1(b), both verified. The bank's own deck note for Q0105 quotes the BPA definition from 'RFO 12.201-1 Simplified Procedures'. A bare 'RFO FAR 13' cite was incomplete. Answer content unchanged.

changes.type: stem ambiguity / currency of the source
changes.before: Which OMB circular establishes cost principles for State, local and Indian tribal government recipients?
changes.after: In the OMB circular framework, which circular set the cost principles for State, local and Indian tribal government recipients before those principles were consolidated into 2 CFR 200 subpart E?
changes.reason: The bank answer is OMB Circular A-87, which is the study-group answer, but A-87 (like A-21 and A-122) was consolidated into the 2 CFR 200 uniform guidance, so a present-tense 'establishes' made the stem answerable two ways: A-87 historically, 2 CFR 200 subpart E today. The past-tense stem keeps the bank's correct answer while removing the ambiguity, and the correct option's 'why' now tells the candidate where the principles live today. Distractors unchanged.

changes.before: Which is a real limitation on using LCS funds?
changes.after: Which of the following is a limitation on the use of LCS funds?
changes.reason: 'a real limitation' implied the other options were fabricated rather than merely wrong, which is a tell. Content unchanged; the correct option still matches the bank answer (LCS limited to Korean firms, Korean material and labor).
